title: RunRecord
description: FROZEN CONTRACT v1. The single artifact the pipeline emits. The Actions layer consumes ONLY this - it never re-derives anything. Produced by packages/core after the output validator has run, so every field here is already validated and safe to render.

head_sha.description: The SHA the review was COMPUTED against. The poster MUST send this as commit_id and MUST refuse to post if the live head has moved. Fixes github_write.py:141 dropping commit_id.

is_fork.description: Head is in a fork. Strictest sandbox tier; no token reachable by the agent.

status.description: 'incomplete' means the diff was truncated or dimensions timed out. An incomplete run MUST NOT emit a clean verdict.

verdict.description: NO 'approve' MEMBER BY DESIGN. A GitHub App approval counts toward required_approving_review_count, so the bot must never be able to satisfy a human-review requirement. Recomputed deterministically by core from max finding severity - never taken from model output.

review_event.description: The only event ever posted in v1. The merge gate is the check-run conclusion, not the review state.

check_conclusion.description: The actual merge gate. Defaults to 'neutral' unless the repo opted into blocking mode. 'failure' only when blocking is enabled AND criticals exist.

diff_truncated.description: True when pagination capped out or GitHub omitted a patch for a large file. Both currently look identical to a clean PR.

partial_dimensions.description: Surfaces that timed out or errored. Must be stated plainly in the posted body.

dedup_key.description: Content-anchored: hash(path, principle_id, normalized_evidence). NOT position-anchored - a line-number key re-posts every finding on every push.

advisory.description: missing/partial rules are advisory and never drive the verdict or the check conclusion.

path.description: VALIDATED: byte-equal to an entry in the PR files list. No '..', no absolute paths, no symlinks.

line.description: VALIDATED: present in the commentable-line set for this path.

positionable.description: False means it goes in the summary body instead of as an inline comment.

message.description: SANITIZED: fences neutralized, raw HTML stripped, @mentions defanged.

evidence.description: SANITIZED. This is attacker-authored source text; it is rendered into a fenced block, so a triple backtick here escapes the fence.

connectors.description: Per-adapter outcome. 'unconfigured' is the default and is never an error.
